<thought>The main ion at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to [M+H]+, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. Searching integer combinations of C, H, O (and optionally other elements) that match this mass, the formula C₈H₁₆O₅ yields a calculated mass of 192.0998 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value, making it the best fit.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
